_comment: Weapon families (DESIGN.md section 21). A family is one kind of weapon with an item per tier (wood, gold, stone, iron, diamond, netherite). Each Drifter has a favorite family and makes it at the tiers in craft_at (with the game's own recipes; if the recipe is missing it makes the vanilla sword instead). 'share': this family takes that share of Drifters before the others are weighed (vanilla swords: about one in four stick with them when weapon mods add other families). 'weight' and 'likes' (personality traits, -1 to 1: how much a high trait pulls toward it) weigh the rest. 'two_handed': with Better Combat installed it means no shield, so careful Drifters lean away. 'requires': a mod id; the file is skipped without it. Datapacks can add files; a family with the same id replaces this one.
